reason: NONE. First thing I saw was $29.99 for 30 sachets, which is a dollar a day. I got Toplux 8 forms in a flash sale for half that and the bottle lasts 3 months, so the sachets and the lab QR code are nice but not worth double to me.
objection: A dollar a day for magnesium when I can get a 3 month bottle for about $15 on a deal. Pretty packaging and a lab report don't change my price per day.
